title: Factual accuracy and political bias remain critical AI output issues: Campbell Brown
description: Campbell Brown, Forum AI Founder and CEO, said at the CNBC Technology Executive Council Summit in New York City on October 28, 2026 that said recent research by her firm suggests that 40% of all AI outputs had at least one major mistake or got one claim wrong. That is being amplified in the lead-up to the midterm elections, when people turn to chatbots or AI-powered search engines to ask where their polling places are or when they need to register.

title: Artificial intelligence use doubles in rural Nebraska, poll shows
description: The latest results from the 2026 Nebraska Rural Poll show that most rural Nebraskans have used artificial intelligence tools.
